inlines.v: UNLIM'ITED, adjective 1. Not limited; having no bounds; boundless. 2. Undefined; indefinite; not bounded by proper exceptions; as unlimited terms. 3. Unconfined; not restrained. Ascribe not to God such as unlimited exercise of mercy as may destroy his justice. Unlimited problem, is one which is capable of infinite solutions.
